comment: Original name TgProcessMarker.textCopy (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the static copy of the marker text in TgProcessMarker (strlen < 0x100, copied, restored after each trigger)); was DAT_10032e40.
Original name panTable (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the 17 x 17 sine pan table MxInitialize fills (MIXER.C static)); was DAT_10033560.
Original name mixBufSize (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the size MxInitialize stores (param +8, doubled) and allocates for mixBuf (MIXER.C static)); was DAT_1002df24.
Original name lipSfx1ID (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the first sfx lip-sync slot of LoadLip (compared with the sound id, set, cleared), beside lipStreamID); was DAT_10031e74.

Original name lipSfx2ID (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the second sfx lip-sync slot of LoadLip and iMUSE_GetPhoneme (a sound id, not the data: the remaster's lipStreamID / lipSfx1ID / lipSfx2ID / lipSfx3ID are four consecutive ints, as here)); was g_dwLipSfx2Data.
Original name lipSfx3ID (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the third sfx lip-sync slot of LoadLip and iMUSE_GetPhoneme (a sound id, not the data)); was g_dwLipSfx3Data.
Original name lipStreamData (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the buffer LoadLip reads the stream lip-sync file (id 10000) into); was DAT_1002f3e8.
Original name lipSfx1Data (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the buffer LoadLip reads into for slot lipSfx1ID); was DAT_1002e340.
Original name lipSfx2Data (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the buffer LoadLip reads into for slot lipSfx2ID); was DAT_1002ec18.
Original name lipSfx3Data (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the buffer LoadLip reads into for slot lipSfx3ID); was DAT_1002fbd0.
